title: Aegis system
description: a simple and very customazable rpg plugin that includes mana, abilities, classes and more!
body:
### **_⚔️ AEGIS_**
Class-based RPG system (Skript)

AEGIS is a modular RPG framework built with Skript, focused on class abilities, skills, and progression.
It’s designed as a foundation for RPG / MMO-style survival servers.

### **_✨ Features_**

4 classes: Warrior, Mage, Archer, Necromancer

Skill system with caps:

Strength, Intelligence, Vitality, Dexterity, Faith

Mana & cooldown-based abilities

Necromancer summons (safe AI, no owner damage)

Skill points from playtime & class actions

Rebirth system to reset and reroll your class

Clean GUIs & modular scripts

### **_📦 Requirements_**

Skript (2.14+)

SkBee

This is not a standalone plugin — Skript is required.

### ⚙️ Installation

Install Skript & SkBee

# extract the file! 

Put all aegis_*.sk files in:
```
plugins/Skript/scripts/
```

Restart or run:


```
/sk reload all
```


### 🎮 Commands
```
/aegis — plugin info & help

/aegis codex — receive a random class

/skills — spend skill points

/recipe — rebirth scroll recipe
```

### 🧠 Ability Use
Sneak + Drop (Q)


Uses mana and has a cooldown.

### ⚠️ Notes!!

Designed for small → mid servers

Easy to extend & customize

Early versions may change

### ❤️ Credits

Made by Safybara using Skript & SkBee.
